name: CRESST
full_name: Cryogenic Rare Event Search with Superconducting Thermometers
summary: CRESST measures tiny nuclear recoils with cryogenic crystal calorimeters at LNGS. Small CaWO4 modules in its third generation extend the search to sub-GeV dark matter.
detection_principle: Superconducting temperature sensors measure phonons, and a separate light detector measures scintillation. Light yield helps identify recoil species and backgrounds, while small absorbers reduce heat capacity and the detection threshold.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
